text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait! Look at the way Kura-chan's 
running!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During the race, Satono Diamond, who was 
watching beside me, spoke to me over and 
over again.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That just now was a reflection of the 
other day's training, wasn't it! Next is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having revealed the strategy beforehand, 
she seemed genuinely pleased to be able to 
grasp the intention behind each of Satono 
Crown's moves.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the other hand—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —Kh.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yaaaahh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The look on Satono Crown's face can hardly 
be called bright.
choice_data_list:
(There doesn't seem to be anything wrong 
with her form or legs, but...)

(There's nothing wrong with her form or 
legs, but...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Am I overthinking it? Her stern 
expression might just be proof that she's 
running with everything she's got, but—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, Satono Crown ran a clean race, 
crossing the finish line without losing 
her composure even once.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...! —...—Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet she is clearly breathing heavily. So 
much so that one would think she had 
fallen ill...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, how's Kura-chan?! How are her 
legs—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Looks like it'll be fine, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'm totally fine! The doctor even 
gave me a clean bill of health!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It's a very common story. Getting all 
hyped up for a graded race, ...and getting 
so worked up you lose your cool.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"I burned myself out completely in the 
race and collapsed. That's all it was. 
...It just wasn't smart at all."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry for making you worry, Dia, and 
Trainer too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she apologized, the way she pouted 
showed an uncharacteristically childish 
frustration.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Though it's common enough to feel more 
exhausted than usual simply from nerves.
choice_data_list:
It's okay, you'll be able to relax and run 
next time.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I won't repeat it twice. I definitely 
won't get nervous or overexcited!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...There's no way I'm doing that.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ! ...My, my. ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...? What is it, Dia?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's just, you're acting like a kid, 
Kura-chan. I was thinking it's been a 
while since I saw you pouting like that~

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Wh—
choice_data_list:
(She's competitive to the core, isn't 
she.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how mature she may act, Satono 
Crown is still an Umamusume who just made 
her debut.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't want to lose even to her ideal 
self. She's a growing Umamusume, pure and 
earnest.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?
choice_data_list:
Sorry, sorry. More importantly, what 
should we do next?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Next.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I got results in the prep race! Isn't 
running in a Junior Grade GⅠ next the 
standard royal road?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I think it's still too early.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Today I exposed my mental immaturity and 
expended far more stamina than 
anticipated."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
In other words, I think today was a day 
where we truly felt just how grueling the 
Twinkle Series... especially graded races, 
really are.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Then the very first thing we should do is 
reflect and plan countermeasures. No 
matter how small a risk is, if they pile 
up, it can lead to a major injury."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...Conquering a GⅠ is of course my goal. 
However, if pushing myself now causes a 
problem, my Classic Year...—No."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—There's even a chance it could ruin the 
rest of your racing career.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"So for now... how about starting your 
training over again? Even if it means 
spending the rest of your Junior Class 
entirely on conditioning in the worst-case 
scenario."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I take it back. How could any Umamusume 
discuss her own race schedule with such 
cold severity?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And that's right after the race, while 
full of adrenaline... Yet she set that 
heat aside, completely composed.
choice_data_list:
(Calling her mature doesn't even begin to 
cover it...)

(Calling her mature doesn't even begin to 
cover it...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
If it looks like she can run on top of 
that, we could consider a Junior-year GⅠ, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
In just a few months, the 
once-in-a-lifetime dream of an 
Umamusume... the Classic Triple Crown 
trail will begin.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown route is the 
collective name for three races: the 
Satsuki Sho, the Japan Derby, and the 
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
With my distance aptitudes, I should be 
able to aim for the Satsuki Sho and Tokyo 
Yushun (Japanese Derby).

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
And the honor of being a "Derby Umamusume" 
is held in exceptionally high regard 
throughout the Umamusume world.
choice_data_list:
It's a title I want — for your goal as 
well.

It's a title worth having, especially for 
the sake of your goal.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I will become the pride of Satono, 
and Satono will become the pride of the 
Umamusume world.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"For that reason, let us set our 
priorities. Bearing in mind that there is 
an extremely important race in the Classic 
Year."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
That concludes my requests. Do you have 
any suggestions, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I look at the racing calendar and think. 
To recover the stamina expended this time 
and then make flawless preparations—
choice_data_list:
A prep race for the Satsuki Sho... How 
about kicking things off with the Yayoi 
Sho?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Perfect!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I'm back~.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Welcome back.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"I saw the Tokyo Sports Hai. You got 
pretty worked up."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ! That is—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"You're right. I got a bit too carried 
away. I was just thinking that whether I 
won this prep race or not would change the 
expectations placed on the Satono name."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Is it for the sake of pride?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...How typical of you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
But I've learned my lesson, really! After 
the Yayoi Sho, I absoluteeely won't 
collapse or anything like that!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
And from there, we'll head straight for 
the Satsuki Sho and the Japanese Derby. 
Wouldn't you have a similar plan, 
Duramente-san?
